appearance:
Appearance

Each cell type carries its own style group. Checkbox sets the checked and unchecked colors, the focus ring, and the shape. Select sets the trigger surface and the checked-option icon color, and Dropdown paints the option list. AddRowButton and BulkEditButton set the action button label, icon, color, and shape.

Usage 

@uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldset(uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetSettings{
	Columns: []uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumn{
		{Id: "host", Label: "Host", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeText},
		{Id: "protocol", Label: "Protocol", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeSelect, Options: protocolOptions},
		{Id: "enabled", Label: "Enabled", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeCheckbox},
	},
	TwoWayStatePath: "endpointRows",

	// OptionalFields
	AddRowButton: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetAddRowButtonStyle{
		BackgroundColor:      "emerald-500",
		BackgroundColorHover: "emerald-400",
		IconLeft:             "ph-plus-circle",
		Shape:                uiToolset.ShapeCircular,
		TextColor:            "neutral-950",
		TextColorHover:       "neutral-950",
	},
	AddRowLabel: "Add endpoint",
	BulkEdit: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetBulkEditSettings{
		IsEnabled:       true,
		ButtonIcon:      "ph-clipboard-text",
		ButtonLabel:     "Paste endpoints",
		TableButtonIcon: "ph-table",
		TableButtonLabel: "Show endpoints",
	},
	BulkEditButton: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetBulkEditButtonStyle{
		BackgroundColor:      "neutral-50/5",
		BackgroundColorHover: "neutral-50/10",
		Shape:                uiToolset.ShapeSquare,
		TextColor:            "emerald-400",
		TextColorHover:       "emerald-300",
	},
	Checkbox: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetCheckboxStyle{
		CheckedColor: "emerald-500",
		Shape:        uiToolset.ShapeCircular,
	},
	Dropdown: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetDropdownStyle{
		BackgroundColor: "neutral-900",
		BorderColor:     "neutral-50/20",
	},
	Select: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetSelectStyle{
		SelectedIconColor: "emerald-400",
		Trigger: uiForm.SelectInputTriggerStyle{
			BackgroundColor: "neutral-50/5",
			BorderColor:     "neutral-50/10",
		},
	},
})

delimiters:
Environment Variables

Bulk edit turns the rows into one textarea line per row, so a whole block can be pasted at once. For two columns the default delimiter is =, and blank lines are ignored. A text-only row with every cell empty is skipped.

Usage 

@uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldset(uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetSettings{
	Columns: []uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumn{
		{Id: "name", Label: "Name", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeText, IsRequired: true},
		{Id: "value", Label: "Value", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeText},
	},
	TwoWayStatePath: "envVarRows",

	// OptionalFields
	BulkEdit: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetBulkEditSettings{
		IsEnabled:     true,
		TextAreaLabel: "Environment variables",
		HintValue:     "One variable per line, in NAME=value form. Blank lines are ignored.",
	},
})

envVarRows:

Typed Columns

The default | delimiter and the checkbox and select cells round-trip through the same textarea. The hidden input carries the parsed rows as JSON.

Usage 

@uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldset(uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetSettings{
	Columns: []uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumn{
		{Id: "name", Label: "Name", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeText},
		{Id: "role", Label: "Role", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeSelect,
			Options: []uiForm.SelectLabelValueOption{{Label: "Owner", Value: "owner"}, {Label: "Member", Value: "member"}}},
		{Id: "enabled", Label: "Enabled", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeCheckbox},
	},
	TwoWayStatePath: "typedBulkRows",
	InputName:       "typedBulkRows",

	// OptionalFields
	BulkEdit: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetBulkEditSettings{
		IsEnabled:     true,
		TextAreaLabel: "Typed rows",
		HintValue:     "One row per line, in name|role|enabled form.",
	},
})

typedBulkRows:

Port Bindings

Four columns default to the | delimiter, so a block of service|publicPort|containerPort|protocol lines can be pasted at once. The hidden input carries the parsed rows as JSON.

Usage 

@uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldset(uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetSettings{
	Columns: []uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumn{
		{Id: "serviceName", Label: "Service Name", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeSelect,
			Options: []uiForm.SelectLabelValueOption{{Label: "Web", Value: "web"}, {Label: "Custom", Value: "custom"}}},
		{Id: "publicPort", Label: "Public Port", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeText},
		{Id: "containerPort", Label: "Container Port", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeText},
		{Id: "protocol", Label: "Protocol", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeSelect,
			Options: []uiForm.SelectLabelValueOption{{Label: "TCP", Value: "tcp"}, {Label: "UDP", Value: "udp"}}},
	},
	TwoWayStatePath: "portBindingRows",
	InputName:       "portBindingRows",

	// OptionalFields
	BulkEdit: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetBulkEditSettings{
		IsEnabled:     true,
		TextAreaLabel: "Port bindings",
	},
})

		{Id: "name", Label: "Name", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeText},
		{Id: "role", Label: "Role", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeSelect,
			Options: []uiForm.SelectLabelValueOption{{Label: "Owner", Value: "owner"}, {Label: "Member", Value: "member"}}},
		{Id: "enabled", Label: "Enabled", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeCheckbox},
	},
	TwoWayStatePath: "customDelimiterRows",

empty-state:
Empty State

With no rows the table shows the empty-state row. AddRowLabel and EmptyStateLabel replace the default Add row and No rows yet texts.

Usage 

@uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldset(uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetSettings{
	Columns: []uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumn{
		{Id: "hostPort", Label: "Host port", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeNumber, Min: "1", Max: "65535"},
		{Id: "protocol", Label: "Protocol", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeSelect, Options: protocolOptions},
	},
	TwoWayStatePath: "portRows",

	// OptionalFields
	AddRowLabel:     "Add port mapping",
	EmptyStateLabel: "No port mappings yet",
})

per-row-validation:
Per-Row Validation

Each row validates on its own. A required cell with an empty value paints a red border and sets aria-invalid until the user fills it.

Usage 

@uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldset(uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetSettings{
	Columns: []uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumn{
		{Id: "name", Label: "Name", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeText, IsRequired: true},
		{Id: "email", Label: "Email", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeText, IsRequired: true},
	},
	TwoWayStatePath: "contactRows",
})

Sizes

Size takes an InputFieldSize* constant and applies it to every cell: the text and number fields, the select, and the checkbox. The select dropdown surface follows the Dropdown style group.

Usage 

@uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldset(uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetSettings{
	Columns: []uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumn{
		{Id: "hostPort", Label: "Host port", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeNumber, Min: "1", Max: "65535"},
		{Id: "protocol", Label: "Protocol", InputType: uiForm.MultiColumnRepeatableFieldsetColumnTypeSelect, Options: protocolOptions},
	},
	TwoWayStatePath: "portRows",

	// OptionalFields
	Size: uiForm.InputFieldSizeXs,
})
